headers.//: HTML is the entry point and carries the ?v= stamps that bust everything else, so it must always be revalidated.

Scripts and styles were revalidated on every load — ~30 conditional requests per page, and a re-parse of a 500KB stylesheet — even when nothing had changed. Five minutes is chosen deliberately over a year-long immutable cache: only some tags carry a ?v= stamp, so a long max-age would strand a change to an unstamped file (js/app.js, js/config.js, ...) in people's browsers. This is the longest window that still lets a deploy reach everyone on their next few page views. Moving to a year requires stamping every tag first.
